description: Issue #1178: the shared corpus for the change-set and bundle digests defined in apply-change-set-digest.md, beside this file. @clossys/launcher is tested against every case. Expected values were produced independently of the package: a stand-alone Python 3 script (standard library only) built each change set -- the members the contract added later (integrator, observed.consumerCi, observed.symlinkedSkillRoots, observed.repositoryProfile, observed.linkedAgentsPaths, each compose-skills item's discovery links and clossys/.state/skills.json, the setup templates' files, and declare-root-entry items with the profile they edit or the refusal that names it) by the rules the contract and apply-change-set-digest.md state -- computed its subject by removing changeSetDigest, branch, bundle, pullRequest, inverse and tooling and reducing every file whose derived member is true to its path, mode, derived, item and invariants, serialized it with json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) -- which is RFC 8785 for these values, because every key is ASCII (so code-point order equals UTF-16 order) and every number is a small integer, both asserted by the script -- and hashed the UTF-8 bytes with hashlib.sha256. It then set branch, the title and changeSetDigest from that digest. Bundle digests were computed the same way over planDigest and the repositories sorted by id. The script also asserted every sameDigestAs and differsFrom relation below before writing this file. Arrays whose order carries no meaning were sorted as code rule C8 states. The briefs are each repository's projection of hubBrief (whose members are deliberately out of order), built by the same script from the brief contract's PER-REPOSITORY PROJECTION in its stated member order, serialized with json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) and one newline -- which writes the same bytes as JavaScript's JSON.stringify(value, null, 2): non-ASCII written as itself, and only the quotation mark, the backslash and control characters below U+0020 escaped -- and hashed as UTF-8. valid says whether the change set also passes the contract and its code rules; every change-set digest is defined either way. Hash inputs are placeholder text: no case is a real repository, package or plan.

changeSets.name: apply-with-packages
changeSets.note: An apply-phase set: a Starter pin the base already has, two installs, a lockfile and the ledger.

changeSets.name: setup-public
changeSets.note: A setup-phase set in a public npm repository: the install waits for the apply phase, a skill path already in the base is refused, and the setup templates' files are written.

changeSets.name: staffing-only
changeSets.note: No package acts, in the apply phase: brief, skills, their manifest and discovery links, and the ledger only.

changeSets.name: apply-excluded-recomputed
changeSets.note: Every excluded member recomputed: the bundle, the pull request body digest, the inverse, and the lockfile's and the ledger's before and after.

changeSets.name: apply-tooling-recorded
changeSets.note: The tool versions that regenerated the lockfile are recorded.

changeSets.name: apply-branch-rewritten
changeSets.note: The branch, the title and the recorded digest changed. The digest does not move, and the set breaks code rule C5.

changeSets.name: apply-base-moved
changeSets.note: The default branch moved.

changeSets.name: apply-producer-bumped
changeSets.note: A different producer version.

changeSets.name: apply-visibility-public
changeSets.note: The repository's visibility is public.

changeSets.name: apply-node-id-changed
changeSets.note: A different repository behind the same id.

changeSets.name: apply-ledger-generation
changeSets.note: The set starts from ledger generation 1.

changeSets.name: apply-package-bytes
changeSets.note: The writer package's integrity differs, in its item and its lockfile invariant.

changeSets.name: apply-staffing-changed
changeSets.note: Only the strategist is staffed here.

changeSets.name: apply-brief-bytes
changeSets.note: The brief's bytes differ.

changeSets.name: apply-engine-bumped
changeSets.note: A different Advisor engine.

changeSets.name: apply-keys-reversed
changeSets.note: Every object's members in reverse order.

changeSets.name: apply-integrator-bumped
changeSets.note: A different Integrator pin in the hub.

changeSets.name: apply-no-consumer-ci
changeSets.note: The base has no workflow of its own.

changeSets.name: apply-claude-skills-symlinked
changeSets.note: The base's .claude/skills is a symbolic link, so no discovery link is written under it.

changeSets.name: apply-link-target-other
changeSets.note: A discovery link that points at another role's skill: its bytes are covered, and code rule C9 refuses it.

changeSets.name: apply-link-regular-file
changeSets.note: A discovery link written as a regular file: its mode is covered, and code rule C9 refuses it.

changeSets.name: apply-pin-starter-in-dependencies
changeSets.note: The Starter pin placed in dependencies instead of devDependencies: code rule C9 requires devDependencies.

changeSets.name: apply-pin-starter-twice
changeSets.note: A second pin-starter item: a set pins Starter at most once, so code rule C10 refuses it.

changeSets.name: apply-refusal-repeated
changeSets.note: The same refusal listed twice: code rule C8 refuses the repeat.

changeSets.name: apply-profile-no-vocabulary
changeSets.note: The base declares a Controller profile with no root vocabulary Controller checks: no act.

changeSets.name: apply-profile-declares-all
changeSets.note: The base's profile already declares every root name the set introduces: no act.

changeSets.name: apply-profile-unparseable
changeSets.note: The base's profile cannot be read as one with a well-formed root vocabulary: the declaration is refused as root-vocabulary-unknown.

changeSets.name: apply-profile-prohibits
changeSets.note: The base's profile prohibits a root name the set introduces: the declaration is refused as root-entry-prohibited.

changeSets.name: apply-root-entry-missing
changeSets.note: The profile needs two root entries added, but the set has no declare-root-entry item: code rule C13 refuses it.

changeSets.name: apply-agents-skills-link
changeSets.note: The base's .agents/skills is a symbolic link: each skill is refused as skills-root-is-link, and the manifest lists none.

changeSets.name: apply-skill-through-link
changeSets.note: The base's .agents/skills is a symbolic link, but the set still writes each skill: code rule C14 refuses it.

changeSets.name: setup-site
changeSets.note: A complete setup-phase set in a private npm repository: the setup templates, the Starter pin, both installs deferred, and the ledger's first generation.

changeSets.name: setup-site-root-entries
changeSets.note: setup-site in a repository whose Controller profile has a root vocabulary: the set adds, as allowed extensions, the six root names it introduces.

changeSets.name: apply-after-setup
changeSets.note: The apply set computed once setup-site has merged: every whole file is a no-op, the Starter pin is satisfied in the base, and only the two installs, their keys, the lockfile and the ledger change.
